generalCriterionList.description: The contractors can request for E-tendering documents on Payment (non refundable) for each work towards the tender processing fee. While applying the contractors can pay the tender processing in the e-procurement portal using modes-viz. through ICICI bank / credit card / direct debit / National Electronic Fund Transfer (NEFT)/ Over The Counter (OTC).

The contractor should pay Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) in the E-procurement portal using any of the payment modes viz., credit card / direct debit / National Electronic Fund Transfer (NEFT) / Over the Counter (OTC). The validity of the EMD shall be for a period of 180 days from the date of opening of the tender. The EMD amount accepted in the form of electronic cash (not through DD) will be maintained in the Government Central Pooling Account at ICICI Bank until the contract is closed. The EMD amount to be paid through Electronic Cash only.

The bidder quoting below the amount put to tender should scan and upload the FDR for the difference amount for each work separately, drawn in favor of EE CADA M&G projects Div No.2 Jamakhandi Obtained From Nationalized Bank and the same FDR should be produced at the time of Evaluation of tender. The FDR should have validity from the date of application to close of contract.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Contractors can access and complete the e-tender documents up to 08-10-2026 up to 5.30 PM. The Submitted bids will be opened on 12-10-2026, 11.00 AM onwards in the office of the Executive Engineer, CADA M&G projects Div No.2 Jamkhandi.

The Intending Bidder should satisfactorily Completed at least one similar Type Of work as prime contractor to an extent of 50% of the Amount put to tender for General category And Any construction work to an extent of 25 % of the Amount put to tender for SC or CAT-II(A) for reserved works in any one of last five financial Years 2021-22 to 2025-26

The intending bidder should have achieved in the last 5 years i.e from 2021-22 to 2025-26, minimum financial turnover in all Classes of Civil Engineering Works usually not less than amount put to tender in at least two financial years. The Annual Turnover certificate with UDIN from chartered accountant to be uploaded

The following certified copies duly attested shall be scanned and attached to E procurement tender. (i) Contractors Registration certificate enrolled under KPWD/Govt. Department and renewed till date. (ii) Annual Turnover Certificate of last five years 2021-22 to 2025-26 duly certified by registered Chartered Accountant with UDIN. iii) GST registration certificate & GSTR-3B Return for the last quarter. iv) A Copy Of PAN CARD A Copy of income tax return filed & Balance sheet for the year 2025-26 (AY 2026-27) v) The Contractors belonging to SC or CAT-ll(A) must upload Caste Certificate & Domicile certificate forbeing domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years issued by Competent Authority for reserved works. vi) Work done Certificate (Item Wise quantity Details)/Performance certificate Issued by the competent authority. vii) Scanned copies of the FDR for the Difference Amount Quoted for each work separately. viii) Employees provident fund (EPF) registration certificate ix) Challan showing the amount paid towards EPF up to previous six month. ix) Liquid assets /availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 11.40 Lakhs respectively for individual work (Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc. (usually 30% of the amount of contract)
Corrigendum / Addendum will be published in the E- Procurement website for all modifications / Corrections if any.

The rates shall be exclusive of GST (for service of this contract). GST will be paid to the tendered amount separately as per prevailing rates. The increase in GST shall not be paid in the agreement/extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible

The intending contractors should note that, if any of the lands (either in part / parts or in whole) required for the work is not yet acquired by the Department, it shall be the responsibility of the contractor to take possession of such land and start the work by consent of the owners before commencement of work at no extra cost to the Department and no claims whatsoever relating to non availability of land would be entertained
If any of the dates mentioned above happens to be a General Holiday, the next working day will holds good.
The Conditional tenders are liable to be rejected. The officer competent to accept the tenders shall have the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason whatsoever.
The intending bidders are advised to visit the site of work before submitting their tenders.

As per the Government order No. LT/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dt:-18-01-2007 a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount of the contractor will be deducted towards cess and will be credited to the Karnataka building and other Constructions labour welfare fund.

Any bidder who is otherwise technically qualified withdraws from the bidding process at any stage before a final decision is taken on the tender, the EMD of such bidder shall be forfeited, the name of such bidder shall be removed from the category list of contractors at least for a minimum period of one year in DEPARTMENT/KPWD ,besides making such bidders liable for blacklisting.
The bidders have to produce all the original certificates or documents as uploaded shall be produced at the time of opening of tender for verification.
The detailed tender notification can be had from the website https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in or in the office of the undersigned Ph No.08353-220050
The payment of bills for these works will be made as and when letter of credit received under the same Head of Account from Govt. of Karnataka.
Typo-graphical errors if any will not be the ground for any claims by the contractor

If many bidders quoted lowest same price to the work and the award of work will be done by toss/ lottery system or by obtaining no objection certificate in this regard by other contractors who have quoted the same price.
The work shall be tackled and completed within prescribed tender period.
The bidder should adhere to all terms and conditions as mentioned in the tender notification and applicable bid documents.
The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders strictly regarding Royalty Charges.
Successful bidders on call attention/intimation has to produce the original certificates or documents for verification.

itemList.description: Earth  work  excavation  for  Foundation  by  mechanical  means   for  all works  & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including  setting  out,    shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting &  stacking the selected  earth for reuse in a radius of  50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 3 m.

Earth work excavation for pipeline trenches in all kinds of soils by mechanical means as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, construction of shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, bracing, using sight rails & bonding rods at every 100 mm wherever necessary as directed, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, dressing of sides and levelling the bottom of trench to the extent required , utilising the available excavated earth locally for the work etc., and all other appurtenances complete in thefollowing strata.

Providing and installing at site of work P.V.C. pipes including cost of pipes and specials and labour, including lowering into trenches, laying true to line, level and perfect linking at joints leak proof including jointing of approved type with all labour charges and all lift charges, handling charges including encasing the pipe around to a depth not less than 15 cms with gravel or selected earth available from the excavation etc.complete.  90mm(weight of pipe -0.917 kg)

Providing & installing at site of work 80mm dia. Perforated corrugated PVC pipes conforming to  IS 9271 with prewrapped 250gsm. Geosynthetic filter material by laser guided trencher machine/by mechanical means including cost of pipe, filter material, pipe accessories and all taxes including all lead and lift., complete and labour charges only for installation of site at perforated corrugated PVC pipes including lowering into trenches, laying true to lines, level and  perfect leak proof linking at joints, fittting pipes accessories  with all leads and lifts charges including the refilling the trench 50 cm around the pipe with gravel or selected earth available from the excavation etc., complete with all leads and lifts.

Supplying P-2 Class R.C.C spun pipes ( safe for 4 kg / cm2 test pressure) to work spot including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, taxes, duties, levies, royalty & all necessary works as applicable. 900 mm dia P-2 Class R.C.C spun pipe
